target.title: Support Firefox Beta, Developer Edition, and Nightly
target.body:
## Summary

- add first-class Firefox Beta, Developer Edition, and Nightly browser options
- classify profiles in Firefox's shared profile root using Mozilla's per-install remoting identity
- preserve Firefox Release, ESR, and legacy unidentified profiles while preventing cross-channel duplicate stores
- document the expanded support and add regression coverage

## Root cause

Firefox channels share `~/Library/Application Support/Firefox/Profiles`. Treating that folder as a single browser works for Firefox generally, but adding catalog entries that all enumerate the folder would duplicate and mislabel every profile. Each profile's `compatibility.ini` identifies its last application, whose `application.ini` provides the stable channel remoting name used here for ownership.

## Validation

- `swift test --filter BrowserCatalogTests`
- `swift test --filter BrowserCookieClientTests`
- `swift test` — 52 tests passed
- `swift build -c release`
- SwiftFormat and `swiftlint --strict` on changed Swift files
- built `SweetCookieCLI` listed and selected all three new browser identifiers
- installed Mozilla-signed Firefox Beta 153.0b11, Developer Edition 153.0b11, and Nightly 154.0a1; each real initialized profile was uniquely discovered
- each channel read its persisted local proof cookie through the public CLI boundary; cookie values were removed before capture
- source-blind behavior contract passed browser listing, unique store discovery, redacted reads, empty-domain probes, and invalid-selector handling
- structured autoreview clean after retaining Firefox ESR under the base Firefox case
- dependency audit: direct DocC plugin and resolved SymbolKit versions are current stable; no matching GitHub advisories found
- Public Model Identifier Gate: PASS; no model-bearing surfaces or identifiers are present

Fixes #12
